references.text: Joshua describes the allocation of the cities Ekron, Ashkelon, and Gaza to the tribe of Judah as part of their inheritance.
It mentions the Anakites who lived in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod, showing the earlier history of these Philistine cities.
It lists the five Philistine rulers' cities, including Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as areas that still needed to be conquered.
Samson travels to Gaza, one of the cities Judah captured according to Judges 1:18.
It mentions the five Philistine cities—Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron—in connection with the golden calves as a guilt offering.
The prophet Amos pronounces judgment on Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, and Ekron, the same cities mentioned in Judges 1:18.
Zephaniah prophesies destruction over Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron, the cities that Judah captured.
Zechariah prophesies judgment on Ashkelon, Gaza, and Ekron, the same Philistine cities.
